goal: Continue the original pure-Raw patient-EZ-F1>0.65 objective, without redefining F1 as Macro/NEZ/pooled F1. Target is unachieved until actually verified.
scope: New internal-only information-retention and end-to-end component study. The previous20-cell study/protocol/models/Outer seal remain immutable. No previous Outer prediction or outcome artifact is an input to this study. This is not an amendment or extension of its scientific budget and does not claim independent discovery after historical test viewing.
rationale: Source-level properties, not an Outer winning model: per-window variance normalization is invariant to positive window amplitude once above its1e-6 floor; the original two-convolution encoder has33-sample local nonlinear receptive field before global averaging. Test preserving relative amplitude and learning longer local interactions. Global averaging still sees the whole2s window; do not describe the old model as receiving only33samples.
data: Unchanged original Raw250 banks/masks/canonical channel identities,80patient/7635channel/256seizure/1471965valid-window cohort. Internal fitting uses only each original fold FIT,counts51/51/50/52/51. Original Development and ownOuter are excluded. Inner role hashes reuse the preexisting patient-disjoint train/cal/choice/held paths, not old feature inputs or trained weights. No subsampling/new extraction/resampling or phenotype/manual feature/D1 input.
label_blind_input_audit: Audit ownFIT union only,79 unique patients,not a claim of80-patient waveform coverage in this new audit. Examine finite support, actual pre-window within-waveform SD, old floor activation, zero pre scales, post/pre within-window power ratios and normalization gain properties. Descriptive only, no label association or candidate filter by outcome. Preserve all channels/windows; zero pre scale uses the median positive pre scale within that same patient,never post waveforms. All-pre-constant patient stops pre-normalized family as unidentified,never deletes that patient.
normalization: WINDOW: exact existing centering/populationSD floor1e-6/clip8. PRE: center each waveform, divide by same seizure/channel square root of the mean within-window variance across all genuine pre-onset windows,computedfloat64; constant pre scales use same-patient median positive pre scale. Clip8,returnFP32. The scale is used only to normalize raw waveform values,not appended as a handcrafted feature or fed separately to the network. Both use all original windows and identical physical samples.
encoder_short: Original Conv1d1to12 k9/s4,GELU,Conv12to24 k7/s4,GELU,globalaverage; local RF33samples=132ms before global pooling.
encoder_long: Conv1to24 k15/s2/p7,GELU,Conv24to24 k9/s2/p4,GELU;3 residual depthwise k7 blocks dilation1/4/16 with pointwise24to24 and GELU,each residual divided bysqrt3;globalaverage. Local RF535samples spans the500sample window. Learned filters only, no fixed physiological bands. No BN/dropout/auxiliary classifier.
patient_context: Only C4: mean over complete-patient channels of GELU(Linear96to16) of the same Raw channel representation; Linear16to128 predicts bounded0.25tanh scale/shift of the existing64D hidden classifier. Conditioner starts at zero,identity mapping. This is a learned latent DeepSets/FiLM-style control,not a novel generic mechanism claim; no separate D1 or second decision head.
common_pool: Same pre-latent subtraction,0to8/8to20 phase means,available-seizure mean/populationSD,full-patient float64 Z and96 classifier slots as the parent. Four end-to-end deletion controls each remove exactly one component on short/WINDOW baseline,unchanged head shape and all other operations.
training: All from scratch; seed42+1009fold,head seed+170003,context seed+370003; matched exact shared initial states for normalization pairs and component controls. Same head across encoder families but CNN shapes/parameter counts differ and are disclosed. AdamWlr0.0003,wd0.001,clip1,max30,min6,patience6;patient-equal full-channel updates;FP32/TF32off;chunk1024 with complete differentiable aggregation and two-pass gradients.
loss: Same already registered EZ-directed objective for EVERY arm:0.5 FIT-only-class-weighted NEZ BCE+0.25 softEZF1+0.25 all within-patient EZvsNEZ softplus ranking. No additional lambda/optimizer/seed search or label-dependent channel sampling. Class weighting recomputed only on actual training roles.
screen_roles: Within each ownFIT path: fit on train+choice patients;cal alone selects checkpoint/threshold;held is the candidate-selection score. Thus cal and held patients never enter fitting/gradient updates in that path. Held scores used for racing are selection data,not an unbiased validation claim. No original Development labels or cross-outer-fold global model selection.
decision_rule: Cal EZ-probability grid0:0.005:1,max patientEZF1,thenMacroF1,nearest0.5,lower threshold;epoch EZF1/MacroF1/earliest. All endpoints still reported,including AUROC/AP/NEZF1/ACC/MRR/Top1/bias.
budget: First path screen1:9arms x5fold=45 full internal cells. Per outerfold select best nonbaseline C1..C4 by heldEZF1-0.1sourceEZF1 sampleSD;smallest parameter count within0.005 of highest,then score/fixed arm order. Only if this candidate beats C0 by>=0.02 EZF1 and AUROC>=C0-0.01 on that first path,run that one candidate and C0 on screens2/3,at most20 more cells. Other candidates and four drop controls are not expanded. Absolute maximum65cells/1950epochs. No blind retries,extra grids or post-score rule changes.
interpretation: First-path end-to-end deletion contrasts address component effects under one matched CNN/normalization/loss,not universal biological necessity. Candidate scoring,racing and repeated overlapping ownFIT paths induce selection bias. Give source and paired patient-cluster10000draw descriptive intervals with repeated appearances carried together;never count channels/windows as independent replicates. Distinguish one-path controls from raced candidates and never fill unrun cells.
prospective_allocation: No new Outer inference or full label archive read in this registration regardless of scores. A later formal testing registration would need fixed per-ownFIT configurations and original Development-only checkpoint/threshold freezes before testing; this study alone cannot establish the F1>0.65 Outer target. Do not reinterpret a low internal F1 as a stopped goal or claim success from workflow completion.
admission: Unit tests cover gain retention,baseline floor exceptions,zero-pre fallback,padding/order,context identity,single-head dataflow and exact source contracts. Actual complete-FIT patient direct vs cached logit/loss equality and full-gradient allcloseatol1e-6/rtol1e-5,RNG state parity must pass for all9 arms before training. Failures preserved,not loosened. Outcome-free memory/timing observations may diagnose execution only.
delivery: Code and compact anonymous executed summaries/report pushed to same GitHub branch. No identities,waveforms,weights,coefficients,individual features/scores,patient rows or runtime logs uploaded. Source groups with<5 distinct patients suppressed in public outcome summaries. Preserve all old frozen science and unrelated jobs.
